mapper.select: SELECT * FROM geographic_features WHERE is_active = true AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO geographic_features (id, name, description, feature_type, latitude, longitude, region, image_url, stats, grade_level, textbook, source_type, category, min_zoom, level_id, is_active, created_at) VALUES (#{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{name}, #{description}, #{featureType}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{region}, #{imageUrl}, #{stats, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.JsonMapTypeHandler}, #{gradeLevel}, #{textbook}, #{sourceType}, #{category}, #{minZoom}, #{levelId, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{isActive}, #{createdAt})
